deterministic_fixtures: For True, False, None, omitted, nonzero, premature-bound, wrong flag, and every wrong identity/scope arm row, snapshot state before/after and require exact nonmutation plus no command.
Authentic arm allocates state exactly once, freezes the expected generation, advances phase, and emits exactly one next status poll.
Repeated/stale arm and all bound progress/terminal negatives remain nonmutating.
